decisions.reason: These plug-ins extend the firm's core geospatial integration and software-component knowledge, and their standalone positioning plus strong in-house R&D make continued refinement far more likely than withdrawal.

The building data digital twin service is somewhat more application-specific, but it still fits the firm's geospatial and enterprise-integration capabilities well enough that management is likely to learn from demand and improve the offer rather than exit.

Because this identity and access service is explicitly tailored to GIS integration, it benefits from the firm's related technical base and from knowledge gained after pruning adjacent identity offerings, supporting continuation.

A geodata business process consulting workshop builds directly on the firm's consulting, training, and user-centered process expertise, so it is easy to adapt commercially and unlikely to be dropped quickly.
